analysis.summary: Vikram Thermo (India) Limited recorded revenue from continuing operations of Rs. 12,623.06 lakhs for FY 2024-25. The company completed the demerger of its Aromatic Chemicals (Diphenyl Oxide) business into Vikram Aroma Limited, which listed and commenced trading on BSE in March 2025. The Board recommended a dividend of 10%, amounting to Rs. 1 per equity share, resulting in a total payout of Rs.

guidance.claim: The company is committed to driving profitable revenue growth through research-driven products for domestic and international markets.
guidance.quote: With a focus on building a sustainable and scalable business model, the Company remains committed to driving profitable revenue growth through the development and commercialization of high-margin, research-driven products tailored to the specific needs of customers in both domestic and international markets.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's PAN-India presence and global footprint expansion have contributed to its overall growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Our extensive PAN-India presence, along with a steadily expanding global footprint, has significantly contributed to the Company's growth.

capex_expansion.claim: The demerger of the Aromatic Chemicals business into Vikram Aroma Limited is expected to increase the efficiency and worth of both companies.
capex_expansion.quote: The demerger shall be a synergic benefit from living off of the undertaking of your company in to Vikram Aroma Limited as the efficiency and worth of both the companies shall increase manifold.

margins_costs.claim: Total income from continuing operations increased to Rs. 12623.06 Lakhs in FY 2024-25 compared to Rs. 10127.26 Lakhs in FY 2023-24.
margins_costs.quote: Total Income from continuing operation increased to Rs. 12623.06 Lakhs in comparison to Rs. 10127.26 Lakhs of Previous Financial Year 2023-24.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of 10% on equity shares of Rs. 10 each, amounting to Rs. 1 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Board of Directors are pleased to recommend payment of Dividend at 10% on equity shares of Rs. 10/- each, amounting to Rs. 1 per share on paid up equity capital of the company to those shareholders whose names appear on the Register of Member on Record date.

capital_allocation.claim: The recommended dividend payout will lead to a total cash outflow of Rs. 3,13,57,850.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend payout will result in total outflow of Rs. 3,13,57,850/- (Previous Year Rs. 2,35,18,388/-).

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of 7.5% on equity shares.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Board of Directors are pleased to recommend payment of Dividend at 7.5% on equity shares of Rs. 10/- each, amounting to Rs. 0.75 per share on paid up equity capital of the company to those shareholders whose names appear on the Register of Member on Record date.

capital_allocation.claim: The company transferred Rs. 30,00,000 to General Reserves during the financial year 2023-24.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has transferred Rs. 30,00,000/- to General Reserves during the financial year 2023-24.

risks_headwinds.claim: The demerger helps isolate risks between businesses and allows each entity to raise capital independently.
risks_headwinds.quote: The demerger would also help each company to isolate the risks between their respective businesses, raise capital based on their individual requirements and unlock value in future.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to consistent investment in R&D, technology adoption, and product portfolio enhancement.
management_commitments.quote: As we move forward, the Company remains steadfast in its commitment to consistent investment in R&D, the adoption of emerging technologies, and the continuous enhancement of its product portfolio to meet the dynamic demands of the market.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that as they enter fiscal 2024, they will continue on their journey of transformation by venturing into new markets and working on new and complex products.
management_commitments.quote: Way ahead as we enter fiscal 2024, we will continue on our journey of transformation by venturing into new markets where competition is favourable to the company and working on products that are new and complex.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
